_comment: Hand-constructed, byte-annotated golden fixture for sdk.v1.ReportResponse (see PROVENANCE.md #Fixture derivation). Not a real DON-produced CRE report — Chainlink has not published one under a permissive license, and pulling a real one from a live network is out of this row's scope (D, no live calls). Every byte traces to the public protobuf wire spec (protobuf.dev/programming-guides/encoding) applied to the MIT-licensed field list in sdk.proto.
